meta.notes: A potion is a list of effects with their durations in ticks: here Featherweight for 3 minutes. brewing adds it to the brewing stand: an awkward potion (the default base) and a feather make it. long adds msm_examples:long_featherweight, 8 minutes, brewed with redstone; strong would add a stronger level brewed with glowstone dust. Splash and lingering bottles (gunpowder, then dragon's breath) and tipped arrows come with it, and display_name names all four "Potion of Featherweight" and so on. Its colour comes from the effect. Potions need the Fabric mod jar export.
